newsitem.title: USA: FSA announces secondary market insurance capacity.
newsitem.headline: FSA announces secondary market insurance capacity.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday that it is offering secondary market insurance for New York State Medical Care (Mental Health Facilities) bonds.
Insurance is available on maturities 2007 and longer.
And FSA said it is revising its premium for WPPSS Projects 1, 2 and 3.
Insurance is available on maturities 2004 and longer.
FSA also said it remaining capacity for the following: New York City general obligation bonds and New York City Water Finance Authority - insurance is available on maturities 2007 and longer.
There is a par limit per firm on any of the offerings.
For further details, please contact Tom Byrne, Greg Haggerty, or Alan Steinfeld at 212-826-0601. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
